//: Vite compiles this directory with esbuild, which strips types without checking them, so
without this file nothing verified that the gallery calls the primitives correctly. Writing
it turned up four wrong call sites that had built and rendered quite happily: a Field taking
`name` and `invalid`, which it does not have; a TablePager taking page props belonging to
Pagination; and a destructive menu item spelled as shadcn's `variant` rather than this
`resolveJsonModule` because the brand and mode lists are read from tokens.json rather than
restated here. The test directory is included: the harness is TypeScript too, and Playwright
transforms it the same way Vite does, with the same absence of checking.
